title: 372. Integer to English Words

examples.explanation: 123 reads as one hundred twenty three.

hints: Split the number into groups of three digits (thousands, millions, billions) and convert each group under 1000 separately.
Handle zero alone as "Zero"; skip any three-digit group that equals zero so no extra scale word appears.
Use word lists for 0-19 and tens (Twenty, Thirty, ...) plus "Hundred" for the sub-thousand helper.
